svg.title: Fast loop · frame to evidence
svg.desc: Aligned camera frames feed Hailo inference and CPU tracking, while RGB, depth and confidence are combined with tracked regions to compute buffered spatiotemporal features.

g.text: Temporal: persistence · area evolution · centroid motion
Optical flow: Farneback → direction / divergence / curl
Depth: invalid ratio · temporal depth variance
Features use matching RGB, depth and tracked regions

svg.text: One synchronized frame bundle feeds inference and feature extraction. Optical flow and depth are supporting evidence.
